Some very good food, but mostly disappointing experience.
Oct 2024 • Couples
We made a reservation online because they have very limited open hours. Walking to the address, we discovered a dark locked gate. Fortunately, my husband knew enough French to read that the main entrance is behind on a parallel street. Once there, the entrance looked very appealing. Our guide book described "a beautiful courtyard seating area," and the TripAdvisor description seemed to confirm, which we requested. Unfortunately, the comments in my reservation were ignored and outside dining was not offered at all with no explanation (it was 72 degrees out, and clear skies). We try very hard to never eat inside since spring 2020, but after walking 45 minutes to dinner, we decided to stay.

The meal started out great. Appetizers were excellent, and presented nicely. No complementary snacks as so many Tunisian restaurants have here. The main course was more of a problem. My husband is vegetarian. As there were no vegetarian entrees on the menu, he requested some of the sides from the meat dishes. The waiter said that was not possible, and only offered pasta with vegetables. It looked nice, and the pasta was cooked well, but it didn't have much flavor. My fish with curry sauce and mango chutney was so good that I gave a little of the sauce to my husband. Dessert was ok, nothing special. 

At the end of the meal, we asked the waiter to call a taxi. Much to our surprise, he refused, and told us to walk around and just find one. This really put a damper on any appreciation for the better aspects of this dining experience.

OK but too expensive for the quality
Feb 2024 • Friends
Pleasant setting and beautiful garden
Calm atmosphere.
Urgent or insistent service
Varied menu with French dishes and local cuisine. Correct quality of products.
My artichoke starter was correct but the garnish was too strong (too much raw garlic). My monkfish dish was OK but undercooked fish, random sauce and vegetables in small quantities and above all overcooked.

Room staff quite pressing, not smiling. It’s also a shame that a restaurant of this category accepts a smoking area which is not completely separated from the non-smoking area. It’s a shame in 2024.

Allow 50 euros per person with a local wine. Which is relatively expensive.

In short, a mixed experience. It's ok, but cuisine without brilliance, expensive and stuffy.

French haute cuisine at its best
Feb 2020 • Friends
French haute cuisine at its finest set in what must be one of the most beautiful courtyards in tunis. 

This restaurant truly sums up the quality that can be found here in Tunis in terms of french haute cuisine. The menu is broad with interesting items such a tongue. 
I had the privilege to have a three course meal here and from the moment i arrived Riadh, the owner welcomed me to his restaurant with a warm greeting that immediately made me fell at home. 

I started with artichokes & prawns then moved on to one of the specialities of the house the calamari, after a brief respite i dived into the perfectly cooked fish main & finished with a lemon pie. All of the dishes i was served where presented perfectly & tasted out of this world. 

If you are looking for a restaurant for a special occasion then i can highly recommend this place the professionalism of the staff & quality of the food is sublime. I will defiantly be back.
